subject: Encord & Cisco
text:
Hi [NAME],

[SENDER] Flemming (formerly Browning) recently joined us here at Encord and
mentioned your work at Cisco speaking very highly of it (She also wanted to
pass on the hello to Jean Franciis Dal and [SENDER] Lazaridis at Cisco!)

In case you're not familiar, Encord we're a Series B scale-up ($50m raised)
and act as the annotation and quality infrastructure behind over 200 AI
teams, including Synthesia, Captions, and Archetype AI. We focus on
consolidating data curation, annotation and model evaluation with the goals
of efficiency gains for training dataset preparation & model iterations.

Would you be open to a quick 15-min call next Weds/Thurs afternoon? [SENDER]
and I would love to get your thoughts and see what you're building at Cisco
and if anything we do is relevant to anything you're exploring.

Look forward to connecting.

subject: [Invite] Encord's CVPR AI Leaders Fireside Chat & Dinner - 06/14
text:
Hi [NAME], 

I saw that you were at CVPR next week, I'd love to personally invite you to a small dinner we're hosting for a group of AI leaders on 06/14.

We'll kick off with a fireside chat featuring Luc Vincent (former VP of AI at Meta, now Chief R&D Officer at Nexar), followed by a relaxed dinner and conversation with guests from Captions, Woven by Toyota, Pickle Robot, and other leading AI/ML teams.

Here are the details:
Date & Time: Saturday, June 14 at 6:30 PM Location: Moto Cucina (a 15-minute walk from the CVPR venue) Guests: A select group of ~20 CTOs, Heads of AI, and Founders from top AI teams. Confirmed attendees include leaders from Captions, Woven by Toyota, and Pickle Robot. This is an invite-only event for Encord partners and selected AI/ML scale-ups - we hope for it to be a relaxed evening for exchanging ideas, not a sales pitch. If you're not familiar with Encord: we're a data development platform helping 200+ AI teams - including Synthesia, Hudl, and Woven by Toyota - bring better models to market, faster.

Would you be interested in joining us?
